caption: The video captures an abandoned concrete stairwell. A dark doorway frames bare winter trees behind a metal table wrapped in yellow-and-black hazard tape. On the table rests a flat pane of greenish glass, already crazed and shattered across its surface, with a black kettlebell sitting upright near its center. Throughout the excerpt the loaded center of the pane bows progressively downward. It deepens from a slight dip into a pronounced V that hangs below the taped table edge. The white crushed zone directly beneath the kettlebell widens as the glass sags. The weight itself settles only a little lower, keeping its upright handle orientation. A stream of glass fragments and dust falls continuously from under the bending pane, starting as a small puff and growing into a widening cascade. The surrounding stairs, doorway and table frame remain fixed, so the visible motion is the slow deformation of the glass and the shedding of debris.
relations: The kettlebell's weight causes the crazed glass pane to sag progressively downward at its center.
As the glass bends into a pronounced V, fragments and dust shed from the crushed zone beneath.
The kettlebell settles slightly lower, maintaining its upright handle orientation as the glass deforms.
The static table and stairwell frame isolate the motion to the glass's bowing and continuous debris fall.
